text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Phew. 
That fulfills today's quota.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup. 
Phalaenopsis was once again devoting 
herself 
to the "ultimate finish" she had set for 
herself.
choice_data_list: All right, all that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to suggest a cooldown, 
I looked at her expression— 
and caught a glimpse of composure still 
remaining.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reviewed today's workout volume on my 
tablet. 
...Checking the data to ensure I wasn't 
rushing things, 
I made the right call as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...! I do not mind, but... are you 
certain?
choice_data_list: It'll be fine. I believe in you.
It'll be fine. I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Time and again up until today, 
Phalaenopsis had 
struggled against her own fragility—and 
triumphed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This wasn't an idea born of impatience. 
Knowing 
her track record, I had prescribed this 
extra training.
choice_data_list: You can do this. You have my word.
You can do this. You have my word.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......The tachibana.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A robe laden heavy with tachibana fruit I 
wish to bestow, 
For none could be more suited than you, 
just as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...My heart feels ready to burst with joy. 
That 
was the kind of poem she had suddenly 
recited for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just now, she had composed—"I wish to 
bestow 
a kimono adorned with splendid tachibana 
fruit upon you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For none is more suited than you, who has 
grown 
as magnificent as that very fruit," she 
recited.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words of gratitude rise to my throat. 
Yet... I feel simply saying "thank you" 
would hardly suffice for what I must 
return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... I search my mind. Knowing full 
well my clumsy hand, 
I channel all the joy I felt into verse—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If the tachibana branch hangs laden with 
sweet fruit, 
'Tis by grace of water poured from your 
guiding hand."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Did you just... offer a reply in verse...?
choice_data_list: In a manner of speaking, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't entirely satisfied with how it 
turned out. The meaning, too, 
was as simple as can be: "The tachibana 
branch bears heavy fruit 
only because my teacher graced it with 
water."
choice_data_list:
...I couldn't quite compose it as 
skillfully as you, though.

...I couldn't quite match your elegance, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, far from it. 
Not in the slightest, truly—far from it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Unrefined it may have been. 
Yet you wrapped your heartfelt feelings 
with the utmost care, 
and returned them to me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And for that... I love it.
choice_data_list: ...Thank you. I'm glad I gave it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. You truly have... borne fruit far 
more 
splendid and magnificent than I could have 
ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...It is a most peculiar feeling. An 
unwavering 
delight, and yet... and yet, it is just...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (How dear...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...No, forgive me. We have no time to 
drown 
in sentimentality right now. Is that not 
so?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I have received it in full. Your poem 
shall remain 
treasured deep within the sanctuary of my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days of "taxing" Phalaenopsis 
with training 
passed once more—bringing us to the day of 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wait quietly beside Phalaenopsis as she 
meditates. 
As her Trainer, I've done everything I 
could possibly do. 
All that's left is to bear witness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... thank you for bringing me this 
far. 
Once again, you have my deepest gratitude.
choice_data_list:
Right back at you. Thank you for giving it 
your all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, would I do anything less? 
You have offered me devotion beyond what I 
deserve.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever fail to answer such 
devotion? 
How could I ever fail to repay it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Therefore—bear witness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To the destiny of our salon. To the grand 
ambition within my grasp. 
—Together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pheeewwwwww......

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Can it be that the reigning Queen 
is feeling nervous?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I am. Of course I'm nervous. 
After all—as the Queen, I can't afford to 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This is the fuel I need to make sure I 
don't. 
A crucial pressure meant to drive me 
forward 
down the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I finally learned to see it that way. 
And that's why I've been able to come this 
far and deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won't be modest about it, either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —I'm strong.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I know.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And it is your head alone that I have come 
to claim.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...To vanquish you, the strongest of our 
era, 
and stake my claim as the new Queen of the 
Tiara— 
that is precisely why I have come.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The eras ever shift and change. 
Is that not so, Lady Dober?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A touch premature, perhaps— 
yet the "next era" has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —The throne of Queen is mine to claim.
